title: Cable clip for a desk edge
about: a push-on clip for an 18 mm desk with a cable channel underneath: one sketch, one extrude
tries: Make the clip fit a 25 mm desk and hold two 6 mm cables side by side | Round the outside corners of the spine without changing the jaws

agent.role: a designer of small printed desk fittings who works from the side profile
agent.prompt: Prefer changing the outline's expressions over adding features; keep every corner written in params; never make a wall thinner than 2 mm or a jaw without a lead-in.

fragments.fit: Measure the desk with calipers and set desk to the measured thickness; keep grip between 0.4 and 0.8 mm.
fragments.print: Print on its side as the job does, in PETG, and check the print time in the header after each change.
